title: Would Make a Nice Gift
text: Would Make a Nice Gift. This Vera Bradley recipe card holder and cards would make a nice gift. The stand is wooden and seems durable. The painted flowers on the stand look a little too mass produced, but it's okay. The cards are sturdy and quite pretty.

product_metadata.title: Vera Bradley Recipe Card Holder with 20 Blank Cards, Wooden Card Stand, Cute Kitchen Gift Set, Rose Toile
features: Kitchen accessories set comes with a wooden place card holder and 20 recipe cards 4x6. The wooden block has a slit across it to display your recipe upright so you don't have to make a mess when referencing it

Cards are made of a thick, matte cardstock that doesn't smudge or bleed-through when written on. Each recipe card has space for the name, prep/cook time, number of servings, ingredients and the entire backside for listing out detailed directions
The large wooden base is wide enough for multiple recipe cards or a tablet/phone to see while cooking so you don’t lose track mid-recipe
Reading stand measures 7 inches long x 5 inches wide x 1.5 inches tall. Plus, it doubles as the cutest spot to display photos from vacations or school events!

Recipe holder and cards are featured in the pretty floral print, Rose Toile, by Vera Bradley. Whether cooking up family recipes, favorite dishes from friends, or new dinners to try, this handy note card holder makes it a little easier to follow along. Plus, it makes a great bridal shower gift! (But you should treat yourself to one, too!)
